storyboard.ears: Only 1 percent of Americans have AB negative blood, the rarest type.
Only 1 percent of Americans have AB negative, the rarest type. Most common is O positive, at over a third.
storyboard.evidence: American Red Cross | US population share by blood type | https://www.redcrossblood.org | 2026-08-11

storyboard.ears: Only 15 percent of Americans are Rh negative. That means a negative type is a small club, so fewer people share yours.
storyboard.evidence: American Red Cross | Share of US population, Rh-positive vs Rh-negative | https://www.redcrossblood.org | 2026-08-11

storyboard.ears: Over half of Latin American donors are O positive, but only about a third of Caucasian donors. Who gives shapes the mix.
storyboard.evidence: American Red Cross | Share who are blood type O-positive, by ethnicity (US donor population) | https://www.redcrossblood.org | 2026-08-11

storyboard.ears: Rare or common, your type matches someone, so your donation can matter.
